title: Knowledge accepted project facts
alt: Knowledge commits an accepted proposal, revisions, immutable redacted receipt, and delivery intent together through the selected Memory provider: native PostgreSQL by default or an existing project-partitioned Cosmos container. Current relay requests include project/run scope and Events reads from the pinned provider; the original three-field N-1 request uses the legacy unscoped native PostgreSQL receipt route. Partial scope is rejected and scoped reads never fall back. Events appends a separate project fact with sequence, inbox dedupe, and durable acknowledgment. The Knowledge run pin and Sessions journal remain in PostgreSQL.

steps.label: Caller bearer stays in memory. Check exact agent owner, source run, pending state, expected revisions, and fresh effective WriteProjects.
Cosmos batch: 100 ops, 2 MB, 5 s; project partition: 20 GB and 10,000 RU/s. 408/413/429 fail closed; tests do not claim live throughput.
Original six-capability selections retain their immutable pin; a missing existing-run pin still returns 503.
One provider transaction: promote record; create decision/revisions, redacted receipt, delivery intent, idempotency result
POST accepted-effects: receipt ID, versions and paired project/run scope; original N-1 request omits both
GET scoped pinned-Memory route for current request; legacy N-1 uses unscoped native-PostgreSQL route; redirects disabled
Both routes verify caller bounds and fresh WriteProjects; responses are no-store. Partial scope is invalid; scoped reads never fall back.
Committed immutable receipt; never forward proposal content
Events rechecks receipt actor and project/run bounds against the same caller, rejects purpose tokens, and fetches fresh WriteProjects.
One transaction: derive project fact, assign sequence, dedupe inbox ID, persist exact ack
Acknowledge provider delivery state only after exact receipt-bound ack validation
Failure stays PENDING; caller retry uses fresh same-actor bearer(s). No background worker or token acquisition.
Project facts have their own sequence and inbox; they never become session/run events or change Sessions provider pins.
